properties.displayName: Sentinel TI - Active IP IOC Match Across MDE, Entra and Azure Activity
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Correlates active STIX IP indicators from ThreatIntelIndicators with recent Defender for Endpoint network events, Entra sign-ins, and Azure control-plane activity. Replaces brittle static campaign IP lists with current feed-driven intelligence.
properties.query:
let TI = materialize(
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
    | where IsDeleted == false
    | where IsActive == true
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey in~ ('ipv4-addr:value','ipv6-addr:value','network-traffic:src_ref.value','network-traffic:dst_ref.value')
    | extend MatchedIP = tostring(ObservableValue)
    | where isnotempty(MatchedIP)
    | project IndicatorId=Id, MatchedIP, Confidence, IndicatorName=tostring(Data.name), IndicatorDescription=tostring(Data.description), Tags
);
let Events = union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | project EventTime=TimeGenerated, DataSource='DeviceNetworkEvents', MatchedIP=RemoteIP,
              DeviceName, UserPrincipalName=InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, Caller='', Action=ActionType, RemoteUrl
),
(
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | where isnotempty(IPAddress)
    | project EventTime=TimeGenerated, DataSource='SigninLogs', MatchedIP=IPAddress,
              DeviceName=tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName), UserPrincipalName, Caller='', Action=ResultType, RemoteUrl=AppDisplayName
),
(
    AzureActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | where isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
    | project EventTime=TimeGenerated, DataSource='AzureActivity', MatchedIP=CallerIpAddress,
              DeviceName='', UserPrincipalName='', Caller, Action=OperationNameValue, RemoteUrl=ResourceId
);
Events
| join kind=inner TI on MatchedIP
| project TimeGenerated=EventTime, DataSource, MatchedIP, DeviceName, UserPrincipalName, Caller, Action, RemoteUrl,
          IndicatorId, Confidence, IndicatorName, IndicatorDescription, Tags
